title: 233. Last Stone Weight II

examples.explanation: We can combine 2 and 4 to get 2, so the array converts to [2,7,1,8,1] then, we can combine 7 and 8 to get 1, so the array converts to [2,1,1,1] then, we can combine 2 and 1 to get 1, so the array converts to [1,1,1] then, we can combine 1 and 1 to get 0, so the array converts to [1], then that's the optimal value.
We can do any sequence of smashes we want, and 5 is the smallest possible.

hints: Think of the final answer as a sum of weights with + or - sign symbols in front of each weight. Actually, all sums with 1 of each sign symbol are possible.
Use dynamic programming: for every possible sum with N stones, those sums +x or -x is possible with N+1 stones, where x is the value of the newest stone.
